blurb: 10K Brewing is a brewery located in downtown Anoka, MN. They host live music events featuring various artists and bands in their taproom. The music styles range from cozy campfire vibes to blues, surf guitar, vaudeville blues, ragtime, vintage Americana folk, bluegrass, country, swing, rockabilly, Appalachian fiddle tunes, and jazz standards.
